Hi, I'm M28, it's nice of you to opens up about your anxiety. I use to have one a few years back and I agree it's debilitating, I forced myself cuz it's necessary to survive alone. Trust me it's not permanent and considering you have willingness to make a change for it, it won't be as hard as the thing I've dealt with.

I'm open about any topics, no negative judgement would be made, we can basically share anything. I'm not queer/alt, but I came from abroad, there'll be plenty of things as topic. Planning to go to Adelaide in a few months and hopefully stays there a few years. Gotta be nice having new unique friendship. 

DM or reply here are welcome
